common_time.common_cutoff_reason: Minimum complete output time across required native compartment, valve-seat, probe, and boundary-flux series on both arms. Guard current time may be one solver step beyond the sampled function-object rows.
common_time.interpolation: Only scalar compact function-object and reduced-model time series were linearly interpolated by bracketing rows. No field-time interpolation or extrapolation was done; every bracket and weight is exported.

gas_expansion_diagnostic.gas_volume_definition: Derived Vgas(t) = static total native tankAZone/tankBZone cell volume - native volIntegrate(alpha.water) in that tank zone. This treats the tank zone as the vessel control volume; the wet feed line is a separate zone.
interpretation_limitations: The interval begins at 0.050021 s rather than near t=0 to avoid a small-denominator exponent estimate.
The pressure is a point sample, the gas volume is derived from mesh zone volume minus water-volume integral, and the system is flowing with coupled gas/water/thermal evolution.
Differences from gamma=1.3998 cannot be assigned to heat transfer or another mechanism from these scalars alone; the exponent is exploratory, not a fitted property or acceptance gate.
gas_expansion_diagnostic.pressure_source: The native i4fTankHeadspaceProbes p field: one gas-phase point sample per tank at A=(1.25,-0.55,1.60) m and B=(1.25,+0.55,1.60) m. The matching alpha.water probe remains near zero over the interval.
gas_expansion_diagnostic.pressure_weighting_limit: This is not a volume-weighted spatial average of headspace pressure; the two probes are separate point samples. Each tank pressure is paired only with that same tank's derived gas volume.

reference.curve_note: Illustrative p proportional to Vgas^(-gamma) reference anchored at the first selected sample; not a model fit or a sealed-system validation.

input_capture.enrichment_note: This final JSON adds verified mesh/run identities for the three native-mouth checks, existing reduced-model first-arrival predictions, paired mesh deltas, and active-child rate context. The original first-pass analysis JSON is preserved in ignored scratch.

limits: Both cases are at a common prefix ending near 0.332 s, before the .70 s target and before first mouth delivery.
The corridor mesh has 24468 more cells (+8.18%) than the 299214-cell baseline. It is a localized corridor-resolution sensitivity, not formal spatial convergence.

The two arms are restarted continuations from distinct earlier checkpoints (baseline .2598319592322597 s; corridor .23933195923226194 s); createFields reconstructs dgdt on restart. This is not a single uninterrupted bitwise trajectory.

The reduced model is an approximate one-tank/two-branch line model with assumed Cd/opening, finite line losses, constant water density, and nominal line volume. The model initial feed differs by about 0.634% from the native reference; model equivalent full line volume differs by about 2.08%.
Tank pressure probes are local samples, so their difference from reduced-model bulk gas pressure includes spatial sampling as well as model discrepancy.
No water at mouth/external zones in this cold prefix is a pre-delivery result, not a device failure. The separate historical primed-line check is not cold-start evidence.

The corridor mesh comparison is only an early upstream check: native alpha.water remains below 0.01 in all four predeclared corridor boxes at the available later sparse field snapshots (baseline 0.359832 s; corridor 0.339332 s). The water front has not tested the locally modified region, so the small scalar deltas do not establish whole-discharge mesh robustness.

measurement_definitions.inventories: volIntegrate(alpha.water) in tank, feed-line, mouth, external, and all-domain cell zones; these are water volumes, not mass. Cell-zone compartment sum minus all-domain total is a partition/reporting closure only. EOS expansion means total water volume itself need not be conserved.
measurement_definitions.mass_conservation: Only the branch guard's cumulative finite-EOS phase mass defects are available here, at the exact captured guard endpoint. They are not interpolated to the common output time.
measurement_definitions.mouth_sample: The x=4.79 m sampled-surface integral of alpha.water*U_x is secondary quadrature, not conservative native alphaPhi flux or physical aperture discharge.
measurement_definitions.outer_boundary_flux: Signed alphaPhi0.water sums on ambientAnnulus, externalSides, and farOutlet patches. Their time integral is volumetric; do not interpret it as a mass balance for finite-EOS water.
measurement_definitions.tank_pressure: Probe0 at (1.25,-0.55,1.60) m in Tank A and probe1 at (1.25,+0.55,1.60) m in Tank B; these are point samples, not volume averages.
measurement_definitions.valve_flux: Native signed sum(alphaPhi0.water) over each valve-seat faceZone; units m3/s, normals point +x. A1+A2 and B1+B2 are per-tank net water-volume throughput, not mass flow.

mesh_changed_region_front_status.interpretation: At each arm’s own sparse saved snapshot (baseline 0.359831959232 s; corridor 0.339331959232 s), all four predeclared refined boxes have zero cells with alpha.water > 0.01 and zero cells with alpha.water >= 0.5. The native scalar comparison cutoff is 0.331581959232 s. Thus the very small prefix mesh deltas test upstream behavior before the water interface reaches the modified region; they do not establish interface-region mesh robustness or convergence.

model_reference.comparison_scope: Representative one-tank/two-branch equivalent-line model; native tank mean/probes are shown beside it, not asserted identical to a volume-averaged bulk-gas pressure.
model_caveats: current branch centerlines use the packet's direct compact CAD-generator coordinates
current dry-line native initialization supplies tank capacity, water, pressure, temperature, air thermo and wetted upstream-feed reference; Tank A is modeled as representative
compact line areas and transition losses remain an equivalent-line approximation; the network line volume is compared against current compact CAD and native zones
single full-bore water front per branch; no stratification, slugs, or trapped pockets
front Froude number is reported as a diagnostic and does not validate piston-front kinematics
front pressure is held at ambient only as a declared approximation and has an air-loss screen
unknown valve seat, Cd, opening history, bend loss, and actual branch geometry remain provisional
tank-to-line water entering the branch is stored until the front reaches the open mouth
model_reference.water_model: constant-density one-dimensional filling model; no VOF stratification or finite-water EOS.

native_mouth_check_qualification: Reader reports alphaPhi0.water volume flux on an offset apparatus/external FV control surface, with positive sign apparatus-to-external. It does not convert to phase mass flow and is not the physical aperture flux. The historical primed pilot additionally compares to a native interior x=4.8 m cut; these two native surfaces differ materially there.
